title: vigna micrantha var. lebrunii
intro: Vigna micrantha var. lebrunii, commonly known as the "Wild Horse Gram" or "Indian Pigeon Pea", is a type of plant that belongs to the legume family. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Vigna micrantha var. lebrunii include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
